test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the columns.

 Column-A(Nutrients) Column-B(Source)

i. Protein rich diet a. Glucose and other sugars

ii. Fat rich diet b. Citrus fruits

iii. Carbohydrate rich diet c. Egg white and red meat

iv. Vitamin C rich diet d. Butter and cheese
solution:
The Correct answer is __**i-c, ii-d, iii-a, iv-b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Protein-rich diet** is primarily derived from **sources such as egg white and red meat**. Proteins are essential for building and repairing body tissues, enzymes, and hormones.
 
• **Fat-rich diet** is commonly found in **butter and cheese**. Fats provide a concentrated source of energy and are crucial for the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins.
 
• **Carbohydrate-rich diet** is abundant in **glucose and other sugars**. Carbohydrates serve as the body's primary energy source and are readily metabolized.
 
• **Vitamin C-rich diet** can be obtained from **citrus fruits** such as oranges and lemons. Vitamin C is vital for boosting immunity, collagen synthesis, and antioxidant protection.
 
• Matching the columns helps in understanding the correlation between **nutrients and their dietary sources**, which is crucial for nutritional science and health-related exams.
 
• Understanding the dietary sources of nutrients aids individuals in maintaining a balanced diet and preventing deficiencies.
 
• These nutrients play a significant role in various **physiological and biochemical functions** essential for overall health and well-being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Protein-rich diet (Incorrect Match in Other Options)**__

 __
 
• **Proteins** are composed of amino acids, which are categorized as essential and non-essential.
 
• Sources of protein include **animal-based foods** like meat, fish, poultry, and dairy products, and **plant-based foods** like legumes, nuts, and seeds.
 
• Protein deficiency can lead to **muscle loss, weakened immunity**, and delayed wound healing.
 
 
 
• **Fat-rich diet (Incorrect Match in Other Options)**__
 __
 
• **Fats** are classified into saturated, unsaturated, and trans fats. Unsaturated fats are considered healthier.
 
• Common sources include **nuts, seeds, fatty fish, and oils** such as olive oil and sunflower oil.
 
• Excessive consumption of fats, especially saturated and trans fats, can lead to **obesity and cardiovascular diseases**.
 
 
 
• **Carbohydrate-rich diet (Incorrect Match in Other Options)**__
 __
 
• **Carbohydrates** are divided into simple and complex carbs. Complex carbs like whole grains are healthier as they provide sustained energy.
 
• Sources include **rice, bread, pasta, fruits, and vegetables.**
 
• Carbohydrates are essential for **brain function** and physical activity.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C-rich diet (Incorrect Match in Other Options)**__
 
 
• **Vitamin C** is water-soluble and must be consumed regularly as it is not stored in the body.
 
• Besides citrus fruits, other sources include **berries, kiwi, guava, and leafy greens**.
 
• Vitamin C deficiency can lead to **scurvy**, characterized by bleeding gums and weakened immunity.
